target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew native range includes much of temperate eastern/northern North America but does not include Texas.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not retain as target-zone native based on the generic common name 'maidenhair fern' or personal-list presence.

morphology.look_here_first: Use only as a nonlocal comparison. Northern maidenhair typically has a distinctive fanlike frond architecture with pinnae radiating from the top of the stipe, unlike the more elongate branching fronds of A. capillus-veneris.
